unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section; and when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; or when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.choice_text: When performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; OR when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; OR when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.logic_text: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary, on or about the individual's person or accessible property— (1) When performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) When the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) When the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.statement: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary on or about the individual's person or accessible property when performance of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property has begun before entering a sterile area or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter, when the individual is entering or in a sterile area, or when the individual is attempting to board or is onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property, if the individual is one of the following: law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter; or an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; OR an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter; OR an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.logic_text: Paragraph (a) of this section does not apply as to carriage of firearms and other weapons if the individual is one of the following: (1) Law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter; (3) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.statement: Paragraph (a) of 49 CFR 1540.111 does not apply to the carriage of firearms and other weapons if the individual is law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport, an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter, or an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.logic_text: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter: (1) Any loaded firearm(s).
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any loaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter; unless the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded; the firearm is unloaded; the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and the container in which it is carried is locked, and only the passenger retains the key or combination.
unit_attributes.choice_text: All of the following must be satisfied: (i) the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded; AND (ii) the firearm is unloaded; AND (iii) the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; AND (iv) the container in which it is carried is locked, and only the passenger retains the key or combination.
unit_attributes.logic_text: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter: Any unloaded firearm(s) unless— (i) The passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded; (ii) The firearm is unloaded; (iii) The firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and (iv) The container in which it is carried is locked, and only the passenger retains the key or combination.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any unloaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter unless the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded; the firearm is unloaded; the firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and the container in which it is carried is locked, and only the passenger retains the key or combination.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.logic_text: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter: (3) Any unauthorized explosive or incendiary.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any unauthorized explosive or incendiary in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.
unit_attributes.logic_text: This section does not prohibit the carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.
unit_attributes.statement: 49 CFR 1540.111 does not prohibit the carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.

unit_attributes.logic_text: Title 49 CFR part 175 provides additional requirements governing carriage of ammunition on aircraft.
unit_attributes.statement: Title 49 CFR part 175 provides additional requirements governing carriage of ammunition on aircraft.
